title: MechELK：大型语言模型中潜在知识提取的机制可解释性框架
summary: MechELK是一个三阶段框架，结合机制可解释性与潜在知识提取。通过定位（SAE特征分析）、验证（因果探测）和提取（表示工程）步骤，在TruthfulQA等基准上平均提取准确率达84.7%，优于现有方法，并能识别78.3%的表面错误输出中的潜在知识，适用于AI安全。
summary_en: MechELK is a three-stage framework bridging mechanistic interpretability and latent knowledge elicitation. Using SAE feature analysis, causal probing, and representation engineering, it achieves 84.7% average elicitation accuracy on benchmarks like TruthfulQA, outperforming CCS by 6.2%, and identifies latent knowledge in 78.3% of cases with incorrect surface outputs, aiding AI safety.
